seo.description: Yammaman — made-to-order clothing woven on a 120-year-old Aizu cotton mill.

props.heading: Made once, for one
props.subheading: Woven in Aizu on the HARAPPA mill — one of only two Aizu Momen mills still working.

body: Yammaman is made to order. Nothing is cut until you ask for it, which is why a garment takes three to four months and why the fabric can be one that has not been woven in years.
The mill behind it, HARAPPA, has been running in Aizu since 2015 and its craft rather longer.

props.heading: In stock now
props.intro: Pieces that are already cut and can ship immediately.

props.heading: The fabric catalog
props.intro: Every swatch here can be woven to order. If a fabric is out of stock, the mill weaves more — it does not leave the catalog.

props.heading: Not sure where to start?
props.body: Read how a made-to-order piece actually gets made, or talk to us first.
